sentences.text:
This application has been filed with the following prayer:-
"To quash the orders dated 8/12/2025, 16.12.2025, 24/12/2025, 03.01.2026 &
08.01.2026 by which NBW have been issued against the petitioners in S.T. No.
176/2021 (State of UP Versus Arvind Goswami & others), F.I.R. No. 44/2020 under section 376, 506, 420 IPC P.S. Mahila Thana, District- Ayodhya, in the interest of justice.

sentences.text:
(Contained as Annexure No. 2 with this application)."
3.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the F.I.R. of the case in question was lodged on the basis of concocted facts and the charge-sheet has been submitted.

He further submits that the matter was listed on 24.12.2025 before learned trial Court, on which date, exemption application was given by the applicants, but due to fault of their counsel, the same was dismissed and learned trial Court issued non bailable warrant.
He next submits that the applicants are continuously cooperating in the trial, but due to some apprehension, transfer application was filed before learned Sessions Judge and same is still pending.
He also submits that in pursuance of non bailable warrant issued by learned trial Court, the applicants are being harassed, hence, indulgence of this Court is required.

4. Specific question was asked from learned counsel for the applicants regarding status of transfer application, which was filed before learned Sessions Judge, in response to the same, he informs that some date is fixed for its hearing, but no effective order is passed.

5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposes the prayer of the applicants and submits that exemption application was not pursued by the applicants' counsel, hence, the same was rejected and non bailable warrant was issued against the applicants.
He further submits that there is no illegality in the order passed by learned trial Court.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident from the order of the trial Court that the exemption application was dismissed only on the ground that it was not being pursued by the applicants' counsel.
It is well settled that at the fault of the counsel, the accused should not be victimized.
